description: Redeem a URLGate premium code for the signed-in wallet. Adds the code’s cycles (30 days each) on top of your current period. Each wallet can use a code once; invalid, expired, withdrawn and used-up codes all return invalid_code.

code.description: The premium code, e.g. "ABCD-EFGH-JKMN-PQRS" (case, spaces and dashes ignored)

token.description: Session token (Bearer) when the MCP connection cannot carry an Authorization header

name: redeem_premium_code
title: Redeem a premium code
